testedBehaviors: GET /health returns 200 with {"status":"ok"} on the upgraded fastapi 0.141.1 / starlette 1.6.0 stack (test_health_endpoint)
users keeps uuid as its first DDL column after the PK moved to UUIDBase — mutation-confirmed red when sort_order=-1 is removed (test_users_column_order_keeps_primary_key_first)
users PK keeps PG_UUID(as_uuid=True), pk_users constraint name, and a default that really returns a UUID (test_users_primary_key_definition_is_preserved)
IDBase keeps id as its first DDL column — mutation-confirmed red without sort_order (test_id_base_puts_its_key_first_too)
Restoring APP_VERSION as a ServerConfig field, which extra="ignore" would otherwise hide, is caught (test_app_version_is_not_a_settings_field)
The release flow's text rewrite still matches app/config.py exactly once, for both X.Y.Z and X.Y.Z-rc-N (test_release_flow_can_still_rewrite_the_version_line)
bcrypt hash round trip and JWT encode/decode round trip under cryptography 50.0.0 (test_password_hash_roundtrip, test_access_token_roundtrip)
untestedScenarios: APP_VERSION env override is asserted at the mechanism level (no settings field) but not at the consumption site in app/api/app.py
versioning.changelog (CHANGELOG.md) is declared in .pr-quality.json but never validated
CORS preflight (OPTIONS with Origin) is untested under the starlette 0.4x -> 1.6.0 major bump
POST /auth/token form parsing is untested under the python-multipart 0.0.20 -> 0.0.31 bump (routers/auth.py 50%)
App lifespan never runs in tests (httpx ASGITransport skips it): configure_logging, the AUTO_CREATE_TABLES branch, dispose_db
Every BaseOperator/UUIDOperator/IDOperator CRUD body is uncovered (base_operator.py 54%) — the new generic bounds are enforced by pyright only
_IDProbe registers _id_probe in the shared Base.metadata; no test asserts the app's own create_all set is unaffected
reviewerFocus: sort_order=-1 on UUIDBase/IDBase is load-bearing: deleting it silently moves the primary key to the last column of every generated CREATE TABLE. DDL verified byte-identical to pre-change, so no migration is needed.

starlette crosses 0.4x -> 1.6.0 and python-multipart 0.0.20 -> 0.0.31 under the unmodified /auth/token form path. Compatibility verified against actual usage, but no test covers form login, CORS preflight or lifespan — a manual register/token/me smoke against a real Postgres before merge is cheap insurance.

APP_VERSION is no longer environment-overridable. A stale APP_VERSION= in an existing .env is silently dropped by extra="ignore"; the app reports the in-source value in /openapi.json. Cosmetic only, documented in .env.example/README/CHANGELOG and locked by a regression test.
requirements-dev.txt is referenced by no committed doc — deliberate, per the decision to keep gate tooling out of README. Recorded so the trade-off is on file.

findings: Five review rounds ran as the change evolved; the final refute pass adjudicated 7 candidates and none survived as defects. Items fixed along the way: DDL column-order drift (sort_order=-1), unbounded >= floors in an otherwise ==-pinned requirements.txt, a wrong remediation trigger on the pip-audit suppression, a dead CHANGELOG section, a broken README model recipe, CI/config command duplication, and four defective assertions in the new tests.

Refute rejected as pre-existing or below the bar: test deps in requirements.txt shipping to the Docker image, operator CRUD duplication, the type-check-only operator bound tightening, dead .gitignore entries, the requiredChecks set duplication, the fork-PR self-attestation of external-pr, and _id_probe in the shared metadata.

rulings.decision: chore — the gate/CI/tooling import is the dominant change; no user-visible new capability, and the repo has 0 tags so feat's minor bump or a ! variant would both mislead
rejected — the removed APP_VERSION is a public string already served at /openapi.json; JWT_*, DB_*, CORS_ORIGINS and model_config are byte-identical to HEAD
rulings.basis: round 4 risk, upheld by the final refute pass

rulings.decision: pytest/pytest-asyncio/httpx were already in requirements.txt at HEAD and already shipped in the image — pre-existing, not this PR
get/update/delete bodies are character-identical to HEAD; the AsyncSession.get swap was equally available before — pre-existing, not this PR
the operator bound tightening is type-check-only, documented in README, and the repo has 0 tags and no published package — not a finding
README must not carry PR-gate / pre-PR tooling content; requirements-dev.txt install line deliberately omitted
pyright does not fail on fork PRs for a missing venv/ — it falls back to the PATH interpreter (verified); moot now that the workflow creates a real venv/

requirement.notes: 使用者確認無正式 ticket/spec(內部工具導入),requirement 合規性不可驗證;description 與 diff 的自洽性已由 contract lens 逐項核對通過。

security.notes: security.py / deps.py / routers/auth.py 未被觸及,config.py 的 JWT_*/DB_*/CORS_ORIGINS/model_config 與 HEAD 逐字相同;pip-audit 豁免的不可達性以執行驗證;external-pr 的 fork 自證疑慮經 refute 判定 assurance delta 為零(該 job 本來就執行貢獻者的 pip install 與 pytest)。

businessLogic.notes: CREATE TABLE users 與兩個 index 經編譯比對與變更前逐字相同;operator 變更僅型別層;唯一行為變更是 APP_VERSION 不再可由環境變數覆寫,影響面僅 /openapi.json 的版本字串,且有回歸測試鎖住。

backwardCompatibility.notes: app/api/**、config 格式、DDL 均無不相容變更,不需 migration。APP_VERSION 移除環境覆寫是刻意且已在 .env.example/README/CHANGELOG 宣告並有測試;venv 命名是對齊 pyrightconfig.json 的既有設定,非變更。

testing.notes: 本次引入的兩個 load-bearing 不變式(UUIDBase/IDBase 的 sort_order、版本來源)都有 mutation 驗證過會紅燈的測試;剩餘缺口為既有債,已逐條列入 untestedScenarios。
